waiters.why: This row IS the clock. Its projection writes the exact clock-tick record at the exact address and path labels clock-ticker wrote, so every trigger rule matching clock-tick keeps firing with no edit.

A due time told as a fact, once per due time (the engine admits one fact per event id, and the id is the due instant), the newest only after a sleep with how many it missed. A person's own waiter names its own every_ms, from_ms and zone, or an at_ms; a tool hears it with a wake {fact: {kind: due-time, from: [run]}}.
